name: Mawadza & Matuka, Lingala Dictionary & Phrasebook, Hippocrene Books 2016 (via lingen_djvu.txt)
description: Lingala-English and English-Lingala dictionary extracted from lingen_djvu.txt. This is the ONLY source of truth for the website. Includes both Lingala-English and inverted English-Lingala entries, with OCR noise removed, wrapped lines joined, and duplicates merged. Phrasebook section excluded.

notes: Old Wiktionary data (kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0) is no longer used for dictionary words and is kept only as backup in data/processed/dictionary.json.bak and data/raw/kaikki-lingala.jsonl. The new dictionary contains 2314 unique Lingala headwords (after merging) from 3980 raw entries (LE 1991 chunks + EL 1836 chunks).
